== Biography ==
Jane was born about 1835. She was the daughter of [[Glasgow-1701|James Glasgow jun]] of Killycurragh, Derryloran, County Tyrone. 
<ref name="hs"/>

As of 1901 she was living with her nephew [[Glasgow-1710|James]] in Killycurragh.

She passed away 17 June 1925 age 89 and is buried at Clare Churchyard.
<ref>[[Space:Kildress_Church_of_Ireland_Churchyard%2C_Cookstown%2C_Tyrone]] - James Glasgow jun. headstone</ref>
